newsitem.title: ITALY: Pope appears in public again after surgery.
newsitem.headline: Pope appears in public again after surgery.

text.p: Pope John Paul appeared in public on Sunday for the first time in a week after undergoing surgery to remove his appendix.
The Pope appeared at a window of his suite at the Gemelli hospital to greet hundreds of people gathered in the courtyard below.
In his brief unprepared remarks to the crowd, he smiled and joked that the hospital had become "the third Vatican," after St Peter's and the Papal summer residence at south of Rome.
"Now I have to go back to my bedroom ... I hope that next week we can do this from the first Vatican," he joked. He appeared to be in relatively good form.
In the recorded message broadcast before his appearance, 76-year-old Pope, who entered the Gemelli last Sunday, called the hospital "a place of suffering and prayer".
Doctors treating the Pope have said that surgery last Tuesday showed no recurrence of a 1992 tumour. He is expected to leave hospital either this Monday or Tuesday.
